questions.question: A $14$-digit number $666666XY444444$ is a multiple of $26$. If $X$ and $Y$ are both positive, what is the smallest value of $X+Y$?
questions.analysis: Since $111111=111\times1001$ is divisible by $13$, divisibility reduces to the middle digits. The smallest possible sum is $1+3=4$.
questions.subject: Mathematics
